title: Insurance Agency Desk
description: Insureds, policies, renewals, claims and follow-ups for an independent insurance agency.

spec.useCase: Barnaby Quinlan-Osei runs an independent agency and uses this to see which policies renew soon, which claims are open, and which follow-up tasks are late. It tracks work only and gives no coverage advice.

pages.title: Supporting an insured through a claim

text.text: First call
Express care before process. Ask if anyone is hurt and if the damage is contained.
Collect what happened, when, and the photos they have.
Give the carrier's claim line and report the claim the same day.
While the claim is open
Log the claim with the date of loss and reported date.
Add the carrier's claim number and adjuster to the row.
Call the insured every two weeks even if there is no news.
Closing
Confirm the settlement matches the policy language.
Note anything the insured should change at renewal.
Say what you know, say what you do not know, and say when you will call again.
Information to collect
Contact details and the effective date they need.
Business: operations, payroll, revenue range, locations, vehicles.
Household: property details, drivers, prior claims.
Steps
Create the insured and a policy at Quote.
Gather applications and send them for signature.
Submit to the carriers you place that line with.
Present options in plain language, with differences in cover listed.
When bound, change the status to In force and set the dates.
This template tracks workflow only; coverage advice follows your licence and the carrier rules.
Monday
Review Expiring in 60 days and assign renewals.
Review Claims in progress and agree who calls whom.
Daily
Work Mine from the top; anything overdue is first.
Log every call on the policy page before moving on.
Friday
Tick off finished follow-ups.
Move statuses so the dashboard is true.
Write down the three things Monday needs to start with.
